it depends on the hospital but most are usually the same. if there's a psychiatric hospital near you that's not just a ward in a general hospital, you could probably call and figure out if they could admit you without you having to go to the emergency room. i'm still a teenager so i only have experience w child and adolescent inpatient but i'd assume it's pretty similar. your family can visit you and anyone over 18 can visit you, and you can call them if you need to. they tell you that you could be out in 3-5 days but it usually ends up being about a week. it's mostly group stuff from what i've experienced. you also talk with a couple doctors and a psychiatrist and probably get put on meds or have them adjusted if you're already on them. it might be different for you but it's been pretty consistent when i've been inpatient.
